instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of a bright indoor study room. On the left, the woman with dark hair and glasses (R2) sits looking at her companion, pointing a pen toward an open book. On the right, the man with short curly blonde hair (R1) sits looking down at papers on the wooden desk. They sit together at the table with documents, a laptop, and a glass of water. Soft natural light from the window behind them illuminates the scene.
